entries.zh: 和睦、友爱；朋友与友谊
entries.en: concord, harmony; friend and friendship
entries.notes: H 雍 本义为「和睦」，L 作 amigo y amistad，义域由「和睦」引申指友谊，四栏对应稍宽。

entries.zh: 结交；缔结友谊（亦指深交之友）
entries.en: to make friends; to contract a friendship; close friends

entries.zh: 结义兄弟；情同手足的朋友（义结金兰）
entries.en: sworn brothers; friends as close as brothers

entries.zh: 结拜；拜把结义（结为异姓兄弟）
entries.en: to become sworn brothers by ritual; sworn friends

entries.zh: 会；聚会、交往，亦指会社、团体；朋友情谊
entries.en: meeting, association, society; company; friendship

entries.zh: 会合；相聚（朋友聚会）
entries.en: to come together; to meet, to gather (as friends)

entries.zh: 会友；同会之友、朋友、同道
entries.en: friends of the same association; associates, companions

entries.zh: 兄弟；同胞兄弟（喻情同手足之友）
entries.en: brothers; friends like brothers (children of one mother)
entries.notes: L 末「hijos de unas mo.」为「同母之子」之残句，H 會兄弟 为罕见组合，释义据该残句推定为「兄弟」。

entries.zh: 会馆；同乡、同业聚会之馆舍（亦指同住共处之人）
entries.en: guild hall; native-place association hall; those who lodge together

entries.zh: 友；朋友
entries.en: friend

entries.zh: 友义为重；朋友间情义深重
entries.en: the bond of friendship is weighty; loyal, faithful friends

entries.zh: 友情深厚；情谊笃厚
entries.en: deep friendship; thick bonds of friendship
entries.notes: M 栏括注 (caũ) 系 厚 之异读，删去后与 R 栏 hōu 一致，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 和睦；亲睦（朋友和好相亲）
entries.en: concord; harmonious friendship, friendly accord
entries.notes: M 栏并列两读，R 栏 mō 与 睦 相合，释义据 H 与 L 定。

entries.zh: 交谊；交情（良好纯洁的友谊）
entries.en: friendship; good and pure friendship

entries.zh: 交情；情谊
entries.en: friendship; mutual affection between friends

entries.zh: 朋；朋辈、朋友（交情牢固者）
entries.en: friend; companion; close, strong friend
entries.notes: L「amigos desda fuerte」搭配不词，疑有讹脱，语义依 H 朋 与 R 定。

entries.zh: 朋友；真朋友（完全意义上的朋友）
entries.en: friends; friends in the full sense, genuine friends

entries.zh: 旧交；老朋友
entries.en: old friends; friends of long standing
entries.notes: H 栏仅 舊 一字，M 栏「guiŭ pōng iù」补足为「旧朋友」。

entries.zh: 相惜；彼此爱惜（情意相投的朋友）
entries.en: to cherish each other; mutual affection between friends

entries.zh: 相好；彼此亲爱（情投意合的朋友）
entries.en: to be on intimate terms; dear friends who love each other

entries.zh: 忘尔我；不分你我（谓交情亲密无间）
entries.en: to forget 'you' and 'I'; to have no separate self or other (utterly close friends)

entries.zh: 搭肉衫；贴身穿的衣衫，喻形影不离的亲密朋友
entries.en: friends as close as the shirt next to one's skin; inseparable, intimate friends
